description_zh: 全部使用有機認證原料，麵團至少發酵 24 小時；由烘焙師父子一起經營。
description_en: Certified organic ingredients and at least 24 hours of fermentation; run by a baker and his son.
notes: RAS 2024 參賽地址 Balmain（300 Darling St），該址現在是另一家 Balmain Bread，不建門市；2024 的獎記在品牌。Cronulla 專櫃官網寫即將開幕，未建。介紹來源：官網 https://bonfirebread.com.au/（2026-11-02）

description_zh: 整間店以酸種為主，連可頌、巧克力麵包、餅乾都用酸種麵團做。
description_en: Sourdough runs through everything here, even the croissants, pain au chocolat and cookies.
notes: RAS 參賽地址 Varsity Lakes 是烘焙廠（bakehouse），不上地圖。介紹來源：RAS 2026 官方結果的產品名（Sourdough Croissant、Sourdough Pain au Chocolate、Sourdough Peanut Cookie）

description_zh: 以酥皮點心見長，也賣在家自己烤的半成品酥皮。
description_en: Known for pastry, including take-home pastries you bake in your own oven.
notes: RAS 參賽地址 Fyshwick ACT 2609，Fyshwick 有兩間門市，獎記在品牌。另有週六 Capital Region Farmers Market 攤位，不建。介紹來源：官網 https://threemillsbakery.com.au/「Hand made by us, baked by you」（2026-11-02）

description_zh: 經營的家族在 1980 年代就在超市裡設了現做烘焙部，是最早這樣做的超市之一；烘焙由 Rob Trimboli 帶領。
description_en: The family behind it put one of the first from-scratch bakeries into a supermarket in the 1980s; Rob Trimboli leads the baking.
notes: NABC 2026 得獎者寫「Robert Trimboli - Adelaide's Finest Bakeries & Patisserie」，沒指定門市 → 兩間都收（D2 補充 2026-10-28）。介紹來源：InDaily 2026-06-22 https://www.indailysa.com.au/citymag/food-drink/2026/06/22/upper-crust-australias-best-bread-is-in-adelaide

description_zh: 2009 年 Gleeson 兄弟用一台 5 公斤烘豆機起家，是中央海岸最早的精品烘豆商之一。
description_en: Started by the Gleeson brothers in 2009 on a 5 kg roaster; one of the Central Coast's first specialty roasters.
notes: 官網沒有門市頁，門市取自 Google Maps。Brisbane 店永久歇業，未建。介紹來源：https://centralcoastlifeandstyle.com.au/glee-the-o-g-of-coastie-coffee、https://coastiesmag.com.au/?p=14002

description_zh: 南高地家族經營 30 年的甜點店，兩代甜點師一起在廚房裡做。
description_en: A family patisserie in the Southern Highlands for 30 years, with two generations of pastry chefs in the kitchen.
notes: RAS 參賽地址 Mittagong，獎記在品牌。介紹來源：VisitNSW https://www.visitnsw.com/destinations/country-nsw/southern-highlands/mittagong/food-and-drink/the-gumnut-patisserie；Foodservice Rep（兩代甜點師）

description_zh: 全店無麩質；創辦人和女兒都有乳糜瀉，是新州第一家通過澳洲乳糜瀉協會認證的麵包店。
description_en: Entirely gluten-free, started by a founder who, like her daughter, has coeliac disease; the first NSW bakery accredited by Coeliac Australia.
notes: RAS 參賽地址 Alexandria（也是門市），RAS 獎記在品牌。介紹來源：https://www.afsydney.com.au/about/wholegreen-bakery/

description_zh: 家族經營的手工麵包店，強調慢工製程、不加防腐劑。
description_en: A family-owned artisan bakery that stresses a slow process and no preservatives.
notes: 介紹來源：官網 https://slowbreads.com.au/（2026-11-02）

description_zh: 主廚 Matt Taylor 在米其林餐廳和五星飯店做了近 20 年甜點；可頌每天手工做，一批要花三天。
description_en: Chef Matt Taylor spent almost 20 years in Michelin-starred restaurants and five-star hotels; the croissants are made by hand daily over three days.
notes: RAS 登記網站 www.crois.au 目前是 Shopify「store unavailable」頁，網站欄先空白；上線前再確認營業。介紹來源：Time Out https://www.timeout.com/sydney/news/one-of-australias-best-croissants-is-hiding-at-this-nsw-bakery-092926

description_zh: Troy 和 Samantha Hindmarch 夫妻經營，法式甜點、蛋糕和麵包都在店裡從頭手工做。
description_en: Run by Troy and Samantha Hindmarch; French-style pastries, cakes and bread are made from scratch on site.
notes: NABC 只寫店名＋人名，沒有地址；店主 Troy Hindmarch 和得獎者對上（CANDIDATES.md）。介紹來源：The Bugle 2025-08；https://kiama.com.au/listings/eat-drink/parfait-patiserie

description_zh: Black Star Pastry 創辦人 Christopher Thé 開的新麵包店。
description_en: The new bakery from Christopher Thé, founder of Black Star Pastry.
notes: RAS 2024 另有學徒獎（James Hammond），學生獎不收。介紹來源：官網 https://www.hearthe.com.au/（CANDIDATES.md 2026-10-28）

description_zh: 法國夫妻 Adrien、Cécile Bochel 從市集攤位起家，專做波爾多可麗露（canelé）。
description_en: French couple Adrien and Cécile Bochel started at market stalls, specialising in Bordeaux canelés.
notes: Freshwater 店官網寫已永久關閉，不建。介紹來源：SBS https://www.sbs.com.au/food/article/2019/07/12/two-frenchies-resurrecting-16th-century-dessert

description_zh: 法國甜點師 Yves Scherrer 的店；他做過 140 多種閃電泡芙，也是澳洲甜點世界盃隊的教練。
description_en: Run by French pastry chef Yves Scherrer, who has made more than 140 kinds of éclair and coaches Australia's World Pastry Cup team.
notes: 也做批發。介紹來源：SBS https://www.sbs.com.au/food/article/2020/02/03/pastry-chef-can-make-more-140-types-eclairs；Concrete Playground

description_zh: 法國主廚 Sébastien 的全無麩質廚房，從肉派到閃電泡芙都不含麩質。
description_en: French chef Sébastien's entirely gluten-free kitchen, from meat pies to éclairs.
notes: 介紹來源：Broadsheet https://www.broadsheet.com.au/sydney/leichhardt/cafes/sebastien-sans-gluten；Not Quite Nigella 2022-04-12

description_zh: 葡式蛋塔專門店，用創辦人 Diogo Ferreira 已故父親的家傳食譜，2017 年從小窗口店起家。
description_en: Portuguese tarts from founder Diogo Ferreira's late father's family recipe; started in 2017 as a hole-in-the-wall.
notes: RAS 參賽地址 Marrickville 不是門市，獎記在品牌。介紹來源：Foodservice Rep https://www.foodservicerep.com.au/bakery-trends/136/the-man-behind-tuga-pastries-shares-the-story-of-its-success

description_zh: 全店無麩質，創辦人 Sandra Hudson 一開始是想讓孩子的午餐有無麩質的選擇。
description_en: Entirely gluten-free; founder Sandra Hudson started out wanting gluten-free food for her children's lunches.
notes: 週日、一公休；另有 3 個週六農夫市集攤位，不收。介紹來源：Broadsheet https://www.broadsheet.com.au/sydney/bondi-junction/cafes/hudsons

description_zh: 2014 年從市集攤位起家的甜甜圈店，2016 年在 The Junction 開旗艦店，也賣自製義式冰淇淋。
description_en: A doughnut shop that began at markets in 2014 and opened its flagship at The Junction in 2016; it also makes its own gelato.
notes: RAS 2025 參賽名稱是 MILKJAM CO PTY LTD（同地址，官方的生產者欄寫 DOUGHHEADS、網站 doughheads.com.au），收進 Doughheads。Newcastle Herald 報導店東想出售 The Junction 店，上線前再確認營業。介紹來源：Newcastle Herald https://www.newcastleherald.com.au/story/9018727/newcastles-doughheads-claims-top-spot-at-2025-donut-comp；inkl（冰淇淋）

description_zh: Nowra 經營十多年的在地麵包店，賣派、香草千層和全麥、酸種麵包。
description_en: A local Nowra bakery of more than a decade, selling pies, vanilla slices and wholegrain and sourdough bread.
notes: 沒有官網。RAS 寫 East Nowra，Google Maps 寫 Nowra，郵遞區號都是 2541，附近只有這一家同名店。介紹來源：Localsearch https://www.localsearch.com.au/profile/bakehouse-delights/nowra-nsw-2541/jkKf；Wanderlog

description_zh: Ivy Tran 經營的蛋糕店，客製蛋糕和馬卡龍都在店裡從頭做。
description_en: Ivy Tran's cake shop; custom cakes and macarons are made from scratch on site.
notes: 週一、二、四只開下午。介紹來源：Mosman Collective https://mosmancollective.com/food-drink/sweet-ivy-serves-up-classic-cakes-and-custom-creations-in-mosman/

description_zh: Gabriela Oporto 的蛋糕店，做過 Taylor Swift 的蛋糕，也做無麩質、無糖、純素等特殊飲食的蛋糕。
description_en: Gabriela Oporto's cake shop, which has baked for Taylor Swift and makes cakes for gluten-free, sugar-free and vegan diets.
notes: 官網寫 our Forestville shop。介紹來源：Manly Observer https://manlyobserver.com.au/taylor-swift-buys-eras-tour-cake-from-northern-beaches-bakery/；Baking Business https://bakingbusiness.com.au/five-minutes-with-gabriela-oporto-of-bakealicious/

description_zh: 前高級餐廳主廚 Vivian Wang 的全無麩質甜點店，招牌是巴斯克乳酪蛋糕。
description_en: Former fine-dining chef Vivian Wang's entirely gluten-free dessert shop, best known for its Basque cheesecake.
notes: 沒有官網，只有 Instagram／Facebook；Google Maps 分類咖啡店。介紹來源：TAFE NSW https://www.tafensw.edu.au/about/media/graduate-whips-up-success-with-gluten-free-desserts

description_zh: 聖誕布丁專門店，用家傳食譜在 Newcastle 全程手工做、手工包布。
description_en: Christmas pudding specialists, made and cloth-wrapped by hand in Newcastle from a family recipe.
notes: 官網聯絡頁寫 PUDDING LANE SHOP；工廠門市，週一到週五 8:00–16:00。介紹來源：The Senior https://www.thesenior.com.au/story/7015012/time-to-order-your-christmas-pudding/

description_zh: 全店純素、無麩質，自己做米麵包和甜甜圈，也賣素壽司。
description_en: Entirely vegan and gluten-free; it makes its own rice bread and doughnuts and also serves vegan sushi.
notes: Google Maps 名稱 Comeco Cafe & Sushi Bar；主業咖啡店兼烘焙，收（得獎品項是 Hot Cross Buns）。介紹來源：官網 https://www.comecofoods.com.au/（CANDIDATES.md 2026-10-28）

description_zh: Terrey Hills 的高級食材超市，店裡有自己的廚師團隊。
description_en: A premium grocer in Terrey Hills with its own in-house team of chefs.
notes: 超市，依 D2 加「超市內烘焙」標籤。介紹來源：官網 https://forestwayfresh.com/（CANDIDATES.md 2026-10-28）

description_zh: 1980 年從墨爾本 Hawthorn 一家店起步的連鎖麵包店；這裡只列拿到獎的兩間加盟店。
description_en: A bakery chain that grew from one shop in Hawthorn, Melbourne in 1980; only the two award-winning franchise stores are listed.
notes: 連鎖加盟，依 D2 只收得獎的門市：Lane Cove（RAS 2025 金 2）、Albion Park Rail（NABC 2025 第 1）。NABC 2025 的 Bowral 店只有第 2、3 名，沒過門檻，不收。介紹來源：https://www.bakersdelight.com.au/company
